title: Subscription-Like Cafe Habit by Location
dataSources: Micro-spend transactions (`microspend:txn`), cashback events (`cashback:event`), price tracker alerts (`pricetrack:alert`), and tip logs (`tiplog:shift`).
app: Micro-finance telemetry for latte-factor spending, cashback apps, price tracking, and tip logging sent to Splunk HEC via finance exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=microspend:txn
| search category="coffee_shop"
| stats count as visits sum(amount) as spend by merchant_name
| sort 0 - visits
description: Ranks cafess by repeat cafe spend.
value: Visit counts make it obvious when a cafe habit is functioning like a subscription you never meant to sign up for.
implementation: Send repeat cafe spend events to `index=personal` and keep `merchant_name` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of repeat cafe spend by cafes.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which cafess stand out most for repeat cafe spend.
